facts.fact: Newsmada reports that Madagascar has a 2015 law on electronic signatures, which it describes as the legal equivalent of the handwritten signature; the article's date of 2025-09-13 is used for the report, 2015 for the law.
facts.system: Loi de 2015 sur la signature électronique

facts.fact: A draft decree on electronic signature and interoperability was in preparation, and the ministry held a validation workshop on the regulatory framework on the article's date (2025-09-13, the publication date used as the document gives no other).
facts.system: Projet de décret sur la signature électronique

facts.fact: Newsmada states the 2015 electronic signature law remained without an implementing decree, and the draft decree would give it effective application; the date used is the article's publication date.
facts.system: Loi de 2015 sur la signature électronique
